inputs.text:
Let's talk about what is really happening here, because the message we are getting from the owner of Blue Waters lays bare the deep rot of corporate entitlement and capitalist exploitation. This ownership class expects to drain our communities of wealth while crying victim the second they are asked to pay their fair share, having the absolute gall to complain that the government collects taxes "without doing or investing in anything." It is the exact same playbook they always use: privatize the gains, socialize the costs, and throw a tantrum when society finally demands a contribution.

Look at the environmental catastrophe they are forcing on us. Instead of holding these massive corporations accountable for structural ecological destruction, the powers that be are just floating a weak "environmental tax." And what are we actually facing? A literal crisis where "Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter..." These corporate polluters are actively drowning our neighborhoods and waterways in single-use single-profit plastics, completely refusing to take responsibility for the waste generated by their profit-driven models. Yet the defenders of capital still have the audacity to frame basic ecological safeguards as an attack on the "productive class," entirely erasing the systemic harm these corporations inflict on vulnerable communities and our shared environment every single day.
